additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472004-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / S9 313886545001] Outlet Firmware Update CRM:03288000120
additional_info.body:
Good morning Mr. Huber,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0472004.
I checked the charger
Y2/S9 313886545001
, and it was running on FW v5.0.23. This FW is 1.5 years old, and the outlet was out of order due to an old bug related to that FW.
Between yesterday and today I updated sequentially the charger, and now it is running on the latest release
FW v8.
Since the issue was related to an old FW and now it is solved, I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany

Thank you.
